title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: Bypasses authentication and allows logging in as the administrator without a password.
remediation: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) instead of concatenating strings for SQL queries.

title: SQL Injection Data Extraction
payload_used: qwert')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
impact: Extracts sensitive user credentials (emails and password hashes) from the database via a UNION-based injection in the search endpoint.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and properly validate/sanitize user input before it is processed by the database.

title: DOM XSS
impact: Allows an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser by reflecting a payload off the DOM potentially leading to session hijacking.
remediation: Implement proper output encoding based on context and use a Content Security Policy (CSP) to block inline scripts.

title: Stored XSS (Client-side Bypass)
impact: Allows an attacker to permanently store malicious JavaScript in the database which executes for any admin who views the user management page.
remediation: Sanitize and validate all user-generated input on the server side before rendering it in the browser. Use a strict Content Security Policy (CSP).
